problems.problem: Claim misinterpretation: Agent incorrectly parsed the claim as stating that Sir John Wedderburn IS the brother of Henry Benedict Stuart. The claim actually means Sir John Wedderburn AND Charles Edward Stuart (the brother of Henry Benedict Stuart) were two separate people who both fought. Agent concluded the statement is false based on this misreading, when the statement should be true under the correct interpretation which the previous turns established.
